body.purpose: All shell chrome, navigation and shell-owned pages.

section-title.purpose: The shell's page-level context; remotes keep their own headings.

meta.purpose: Dayline, state metadata and table labels.

shadows.name: active-lift
shadows.purpose: One-pixel lift under the active navigation row.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, activity panel and dialogs only.

motion.name: route-progress
motion.purpose: The 2px primary sweep while a route resolves; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One primary action per region; carries the clinic primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #0f766e); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 600 13px/1 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action next to a primary; never competes with it.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #e2ddd2; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffdf9; color: #1c2422; font: 500 13px/1 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f4ef; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A database-driven destination in the sidebar; 40px row.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: #3d4642; font: 400 13px/1.2 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fffdf9; color: #1c2422; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; color: #6e7772; text-align: center; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current section; white card plus a 3px primary marker and aria-current.
components.css: .ds-nav-item-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #e2ddd2; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffdf9; color: #1c2422; font: 600 13px/1.2 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 36 34 / .04); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10px; top: 9px; bottom: 9px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--primary, #0f766e); } .ds-nav-item-active .ds-nav-icon { color: var(--primary, #0f766e); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Search and form fields; surface ground, warm hairline, 36px.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Buscar por RUT, nombre o email…" />
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e2ddd2; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffdf9; color: #1c2422; font: 400 13px/1 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e7772; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Dayline
components.description: The signature: date/time, active section and its group under the header.
components.css: .ds-dayline { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #6e7772; font: 400 11px/1 'Onest Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dayline .ds-rule { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: #e2ddd2; } .ds-dayline .ds-section { color: #1c2422; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dayline .ds-group { padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid #e2ddd2; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Hexa's shell is the frame of a working dental clinic at mid-morning: warm porcelain, pale oak, daylight and the clinic's own colour. It is a product surface, not an artifact; navigation, tables and forms stay familiar so the day moves faster. The dayline and the active nav marker are the two orientation instruments; everything else recedes.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground with the clinic's primary colour as the only orientation accent.
One workhorse face (Onest) for the shell, with the approved login keeping Roboto.
Borders and surface steps before shadows; two radii only.
A 64px header with a dayline, a 248px rail, no footer.
Every state designed: active, collapsed, drawer, route progress, failed remote, empty.

rules.name: Orientation before decoration
rules.body: The dayline and the active nav item must always agree; no ornamental element may outrank them.

rules.name: Clinic owns the accent
rules.body: Primary comes from branding; do not hardcode a product accent for active state or primary actions.

rules.name: Two radii
rules.body: 8px for controls, 14px for panels; never introduce a third structural radius.

dos: Do keep the active nav row as a white card with a 3px primary marker.
Do use the dayline for date, time and section context.
Do preserve the login's Roboto voice and full-bleed layout.
Do trap focus and lock scroll in the mobile drawer.
donts: Don't use a paper, map, label or credential metaphor over the working screen.
Don't add a footer back to the daily chrome.
Don't make CaroIA, activity, language and user the same visual weight.
Don't remove the visible focus ring or the reduced-motion fallback.
